capabilities: Publish Markdown notes and Pro folder shares to stable DocFerry URLs with optional passwords and expiration
Manage share history (copy, open, update, stop, delete) from a Shares page
Import public URLs, DocFerry Shares, and enabled video/audio sources as local Markdown notes
Carry Pro theme styling into the hosted reader for published content
Sign in with a Bondie account and configure Account, Sharing, Imports, and Advanced preferences
extras: Freemium: core sharing and URL saving are free; Pro unlocks folder shares, higher limits, theme styling, and Advanced Import. Depends on a hosted backend that is not in the public repository. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and users of a retired free-service client must follow a migration guide.
problem: Sharing a single note securely with an outsider requires either a full publishing setup or manually sending files; there is no built-in way to share one note or folder as a temporary, password-protected link without turning the vault into a website.
summary: Desktop plugin that publishes selected notes or folders to password-protected DocFerry share links and saves public URLs as Markdown notes.
